wholePhysicalScope: The Open Cities Dhaka Survey polygon fixes the principal structure. Separate native controls fix the fountain’s location and envelope in the east forecourt.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the five domes, east arcade and mapped fountain. Near views add scalloped arches, lattice and original star mosaics.
limitations: The current public-domain photo establishes the arcade, tile palette and ornament. The current dome heights, spacing and lantern details are approximate.
The fountain follows the survey envelope with an approximate star plan. The broader precinct, street furniture and temporary canopies are outside the model scope.
